user.title: Set your Home Assistant brand
user.description:
Enter a name and upload one image. PNG, JPG, WebP and ICO are supported, up to 5 MB. A square image of at least 512 × 512 is recommended. All required icon sizes are generated automatically; rectangular images keep their proportions.

Save, then restart Home Assistant to apply.

data_description.brand_name: 1–64 characters. Used for the web page and sidebar title.
